_about: Gold set for transcript → structured data (backend pipeline: services/intakeExtraction.service.ts). Hindi lines are written the way the on-prem recogniser (IndicConformer-hi) actually outputs speech: numbers as words, split or misspelt words. Keys: t text; p symptoms that must be found as present; n symptoms that must NOT be present (negated or never said); v vitals that must be read exactly; nv vitals that must not be read; d duration per symptom; sev minimum severity per symptom; h history that must be found; nh history that must not be found; rf whether an emergency red flag must (true) or must not (false) fire. Symptom names are the families in tests/extraction_gold.test.ts.
